about.label: About
about.title: Building mobile products that work in the real world.
paragraphs: I am a Flutter Developer and Mobile App Developer from Bangladesh with experience building Android and iOS applications.

My development experience includes Flutter and Dart, REST API integration, Firebase services, authentication, notifications, responsive UI, local storage, maps, payment integration, and application publishing.
I focus on writing maintainable code using clean architecture, feature-based project structure, SOLID principles, and reusable components.
